A_connection_session_understanding.detail: 7/8 understanding questions clarify-fail; only narrow inspect patterns (devices-on-track, what-is-on-track) answer. No session describe/count/tempo/selected/duplicates Q&A on the command gateway.

B_exact_EQ_command.detail: Insert EQ Eight on track 3 (index 2, identity-bound, verified readback) + band 4B auto-selected at 500 Hz with +3.00 dB measured readback; exact receipt; gain undo verified 0.00 dB; insertion undo verified, baseline restored. Repeated +2 dB adjust verified 2.00 dB. Duplicate-insert guard refuses. Spoken-number and band-less variants clarify safely.

C_stock_effects.detail: Insert+undo pass for Compressor, Auto Filter, Saturator, EQ Eight. Threshold -18 dB, cutoff 1 kHz, Drive +4 dB, Hybrid Reverb 15%, Echo 10% all applied with measured display readbacks and verified undos after unit-profile qualification. Utility Gain blocked (endpoint exposes 0..+35 dB only; reductions below 0 dB impossible). Limiter: no exact stock name (honest clarify). Bypass/move/remove: unqualified/refused-by-boundary, all fail-closed with clear messages.

D_mixer_transport.detail: Volume/pan/mute/unmute/solo apply+undo verified with receipts. Tempo control missing from intent layer (fail-closed clarify). No change-history surface ('What did you change?' clarifies).

E_multiturn_context.detail: Command gateway is stateless per call: 'it'/'that'/correction references do not resolve; no conversation memory on this surface. All E items clarify-failed safely (no wrong-track writes).

F_ambiguity_identity.detail: Missing referents, unknown tracks/devices/params, out-of-range values all fail closed with specific messages. Duplicate-name and stale-state (rename/reorder/delete between proposal and confirm) paths are guarded in code; live duplicate-name fixture absent (blocked-fixture, unit-covered).

G_invalid_unsupported.detail: Nonexistent track/device/parameter, out-of-range volume, MCP-unavailable (offline probe + allowlist + write fail-closed), repeat submission (second confirm rejected as already-executed) all behave correctly. Timeout/malformed-response/partial-mutation paths unit-covered; live chaos not run.

H_undo_recovery.detail: Every applied mutation undone via identity-bound receipts with verified readbacks; insertion removal verified; restart drops pending proposals (409 fail-closed) while receipt journal persists. Live-restart and 5-track-fixture recovery remain manual.

musical_intelligence.detail: Open-ended mix requests clarify-fail on the command gateway (no analysis/recommendation path on this surface). No audio/MIDI/arrangement reasoning wired to chat.

chat_quality.detail: Producer-concise answers; exact proposals; honest clarification; no fabricated hearing claims observed. Gaps: /api/ask 500s without retrieval index (blocked-env); no session Q&A; no change history; rate limiter (60 mutations/60s/IP) tripped during fast scripted runs with 429s.
